content.title: 过去分词作定语 & 作宾语补足语 速查
content.intro: 过去分词(done)表被动或完成。作定语时修饰名词(a broken window / soldiers wounded in the war);作宾语补足语时跟在 have/get/see/hear/find/want/make + 宾语后(get the car charged / heard it announced)。核心判断:宾语/名词与动作是被动关系→用过去分词,主动进行→用现在分词(doing)。

rows: 单个分词修饰名词:a broken window / tired visitors / the shortened name
分词带短语:soldiers wounded in the war / a lake surrounded by hills
请人做或被完成:get the battery charged / had a copy boxed
see/hear/find/want/make:heard it announced / had her eyes fixed

specialRules.rule: 名词/宾语承受动作(被动)→ 用过去分词 done
名词/宾语主动发出动作(主动·进行)→ 用现在分词 doing
specialRules.mark: a crying baby(婴儿在哭=主动)对照 a wounded soldier(士兵被伤)

specialRules.rule: have/get sth done = 让别人做某事 / 某事被完成
specialRules.mark: get the car parked / have the photos printed

specialRules.rule: see/hear/find/want + 宾 + done,强调宾语被动

why: 过去分词本身含被动、完成的意味,相当于一个被动的定语从句:soldiers wounded = soldiers who were wounded;heard it announced = heard that it was announced。宾语或名词是动作的承受者,所以不能用主动的 doing 或动词原形。
gaokaoPoints: 过去分词 vs 现在分词作定语/宾补:看名词或宾语是被动(done)还是主动(doing);语法填空、短文改错高频。
have/get sth done 与 have sb do sth 的区别:sth 被动用 done,sb 主动用 do/to do。

examVsReal.exam: I had my car repaired.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.note: 考试常用 have sth done;口语里 get sth done、用 fix 等更随意的词更常见

examVsReal.exam: soldiers wounded in the war（考试,后置定语）
examVsReal.real: soldiers who got hurt in the war
examVsReal.note: 考试爱用过去分词短语;口语常还原成定语从句、用 get hurt
